rules.statement: The Crown is not to be presumed the owner of scraps of uncultivated land adjacent to the cultivated land belonging to its subjects, but this principle does not apply where the extent of cultivation is a small portion compared with the uncultivated land.
rules.supporting_quote: The principle enunciated by Lawrie J. in Saibo v. Andris[ 1 ( 1898 ) 3 N. L. R. 218.] that the Crown is not to be presumed the owner of scraps of uncultivated land adjacent to the cultivated land belonging to its subjects, can find no application in the present case.
